additionalRules: A Road to Helm's Deep Army must always contain Théoden, who is always the Army's General.
Riders of Rohan do not count towards this Army's Bow Limit.

specialRules.name: "Ride for ruin and the world's ending"
specialRules.text: Friendly Rohan Cavalry models gain a bonus of +1 to their Strength on a turn in which they Charge.

specialRules.name: Legolas & Gimli
specialRules.text: If your Army contains both Legolas and Gimli then Gimli will start the game as a Passenger on Legolas' horse. Whilst mounted, Legolas increases his Attacks to 3 and may use Gimli's Might, Will and Fate as if it was his own (except to improve shooting To Hit/To Wound/In The Way Tests). If Gimli dismounts during Legolas' Move, he may Activate as normal after Legolas' Activation finishes.

specialRules.name: Back on your horses
specialRules.text: At the end of a friendly Infantry Hero model's Move (except Gimli), if in base contact with a friendly Cavalry Warrior model not Engaged in Combat, the Warrior may give the Hero their horse - swap the models accordingly. A Hero with a named horse (such as Snowmane or Brego) will only count as riding a standard horse after using this rule.

specialRules.name: Herugrim
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. If a model armed with Herugrim is involved in a Drawn Combat tied at its Fight Value, it wins instead of rolling off.

specialRules.name: Forth, and Fear no Darkness
specialRules.text: The range of Théoden's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Ring of Barahir
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Whenever Aragorn is affected by a Magical Power, after any Resist Tests, he may roll a D6. On a natural 6, Aragorn is not affected.

specialRules.name: Axes of the Dwarves!
specialRules.text: At the beginning of each Combat he is involved in, Gimli can choose to fight with an axe in each hand (3 Attacks) or with his two-handed axe.

specialRules.name: "I myself am sitting pretty on 43"
specialRules.text: If your Army contains both Legolas and Gimli, whilst he has fewer kills than Legolas, Gimli gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: "Final Count, 42"
specialRules.text: If your Army contains both Legolas and Gimli, whilst he has fewer kills than Gimli, Legolas gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making shooting attacks.

specialRules.name: Deadly Shot
specialRules.text: Legolas may make three shooting attacks during the Shoot Phase instead of one.

specialRules.name: Pinpoint Shot
specialRules.text: Instead of shooting normally, Legolas may make a single shooting attack against an enemy model Engaged in Combat, automatically hitting on a successful To Hit Roll without In The Way Rolls.

units.name: Captain of Rohan
options: Exchange Armour for Heavy Armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Doorward of Meduseld
specialRules.text: So long as Théoden is alive and on the battlefield, Háma and any Rohan Royal Guard within 6" of him count as having the Dominant (2) special rule.

specialRules.name: Arise, Riders of Rohan!
specialRules.text: If within 12" of a Rohan General and has the Cavalry keyword, gains +1 Fight Value on a turn it Charges.

specialRules.name: Spear Mastery
specialRules.text: May use its throwing spear as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't shot with it that turn.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.text: This model may benefit from a friendly Hero model's Stand Fast regardless of range.

specialRules.name: Arise, Riders of Rohan!
specialRules.text: If within 12" of a Rohan General and has the Cavalry keyword, gains +1 Fight Value on a turn it Charges.
